description: Live traffic cameras Queensland is a dataset listed in Peclet Queensland open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by QLD Traffic. Live traffic cameras in on QLD roads, including location and current images captured by cameras - data feed provided by QLD Traffic. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Movements. Its keywords are transport, traffic, roads, disaster dashboard, emergency. The portal shows 138 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-queensland-portal.
